name: AMEGA-LLM
intro: AMEGA-LLM是评估大型语言模型对医疗指南依从性的基准，通过模拟临床交互和开放式问答，涵盖24个诊断场景和13个医学专业，提供比传统基准更全面真实的评估。
org: DATEXIS, Beuth University of Applied Sciences Berlin
scale: 24个诊断场景，163个问题，1497个评估标准
build_method_en: Manual Annotation, Medical Guideline Experts Construction
eval_feature_en: Evaluate LLM compliance with medical guidelines, Simulate clinical interaction, Open-ended QA format
intro_en: AMEGA-LLM is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' adherence to medical guidelines. It offers a more comprehensive and realistic assessment than traditional benchmarks by simulating clinical interactions and open-ended Q&A across 24 diagnostic scenarios and 13 medical specialties.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A(Raw Medical Text Sources) --> B[Data Collection]
    B --> C[Medical Text Preprocessing]
    C --> D[Medical Entity Recognition]
    D --> E[Entity Normalization & Linking]
    E --> F{{Automatic Entity Generation Module}}
    F --> G{Quality Check & Filtering}
    G -- Pass --> H[Expert Annotation & Review]
    G -- Fail --> I[Discarded Data]
    H --> J(Final AMEGA-LLM Dataset)
    J --> K[Model Evaluation: Entity Extraction]
    J --> L[Model Evaluation: Entity Generation]
    K --> M(Evaluation Metrics)
    L --> M
scale_en: 24 items diagnostic scenarios, 163 questions, 1497 items evaluation criteria
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Experienced physicians craft 20 clinical cases across 13 specialties adhering to current medical guidelines"] --> B["Design 135 open-ended questions with 1337 weighted scoring criteria mirroring real clinical interactions"]
    B["Design 135 open-ended questions with 1337 weighted scoring criteria mirroring real clinical interactions"] --> C["Candidate LLM receives initial case and generates responses to questions across multiple sections"]
    C["Candidate LLM receives initial case and generates responses to questions across multiple sections"] --> D["GPT-4 Evaluator Model assesses candidate responses against pre-defined criteria for each question section"]
    D["GPT-4 Evaluator Model assesses candidate responses against pre-defined criteria for each question section"] --> E["Reask process permits candidate model to refine answers if initial response fails to meet criteria"]
    E["Reask process permits candidate model to refine answers if initial response fails to meet criteria"] --> F["Aggregate criterion scores through multiplication and addition to compute question, section, and case-level scores"]
    F["Aggregate criterion scores through multiplication and addition to compute question, section, and case-level scores"] --> G["Validate GPT-4 evaluator alignment with human expert on primary diagnoses achieving 0.98 F1-score"]
    G["Validate GPT-4 evaluator alignment with human expert on primary diagnoses achieving 0.98 F1-score"] --> H["Analyze normalized scores and performance deficiencies across question types, cases, and medical specialties"]
